title: Advancing Equitable AI: Evaluating Cultural Expressiveness in LLMs for Latin American Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM outputs against ground-truth responses from Latin American users using a novel Cultural Expressiveness composite metric, which calculates normalized regional keyword frequency, sentiment alignment via DistilBERT, and semantic similarity via Sentence-BERT.

Analyzing lexical diversity (Type-Token Ratio) and evaluating the models' ability to adequately respond to culturally nuanced questions reflecting Latin American linguistic diversity (including Spanish, Portuguese, and references to indigenous languages).
